entities.name: José de Jesús Pimiento Rodriguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José de Jesús Horacio Pimiento Rodríguez was a Colombian prelate of the Catholic Church who served as Bishop of Montería from 1959 to 1964, Bishop of Garzón-Neiva from 1964 to 1975, and finally Archbishop of Manizales from 1975 to 1996. He was created a cardinal by Pope Francis in 2015.
